verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes only a generic RDAP/WHOIS lookup page description (docs-16, docs-42) that lets users find contact info for Porkbun-registered domains, but nothing confirms that WHOIS privacy/redaction is free, on by default, or free of upsell. Missing for 10: any statement of default privacy protection, its pricing (free vs paid), and confirmation that personal data is redacted rather than exposed via RDAP.
